text:
kevin: quick sync — product asked for clear launch criteria for the throughput laddering work (kernels + quant + KV cache). Planning tomorrow, want to lock must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

maria: +1. Customers (HorizonHealth, AtlasSearch) pushed on p99 under load and predictable tail latencies. we need a list we can show sales/legal.

chloe: i'll bring the benchmarking matrix. currently we have microbench kernels and a prototype int8 path. open questions: canary strategy and quality gating for quant.

sam: suggested minimal criteria: (1) p95 < 60ms at target qps, (2) p99 < 200ms with KV enabled, (3) quantized model quality delta <= 1.5% on eval set, (4) autoscaler stable for 30m without oscillation.

kevin: that feels close. add: clear rollback on quality/regression and a fallback route to fp16 hosted model. also need cost/throughput numbers per GPU for sales.

maria: want explicit numbers we can promise: target throughput ladder steps: 1k, 2.5k, 5k token/s sustained per pool. if we can't hit 5k for the quant path, must show linear degradation and fallback plan.

chloe: on KV cache: requirement is prefix hit >= 65% on production traces and memory per-shard < 32GB at ladder top. eviction policy needs to be LRU-ish and expose metrics: cache_hit_rate, cache_evictions/s, cache_bytes_used.

perf-bot: nightly-run results posted: 1779740000-int8-bench: p95=58ms @2k rps, p99=220ms @2k rps, quant-quality-diff=1.9% on synthetic-eval.

sam: that p99 is borderline. can we instrument spike handling? maybe route large seqs to a lower-latency kernel or faster model variant.

chloe: proposal: launch criteria A (must):
- p95 < 70ms at ladder middle step (2.5k tokens/s)
- p99 < 220ms at same step with KV on
- quant quality delta <= 2.0% on customer evals
- cache_hit_rate >= 65% on representative traces
- canary rollback under 5 mins

Proposal B (stretch):
- p95 < 50ms at ladder middle step
- p99 < 150ms at ladder top (5k)
- quant quality delta <= 1.0%
- autoscaler stable for 2 hours at target load

kevin: i like the A/B split. product needs A for an initial GA. B can be 'performance badge'. Sales can show B as roadmap item.

maria: we also need acceptance testing steps for customers: include reproducible eval harness, and a small on-prem smoke test for Private. add docs checklist: rollout plan, observability dashboards, cost estimates.

sam: action items:
- chloe: finalize benchmark harness and run full customer traces (due Tue)
- perf-bot: produce day-of-week matrix for KV hit variance (automated)
- kevin: draft launch criteria doc for PM review and legal (due Wed)
- maria: collect customer eval sets and success thresholds (due Fri)

kevin: quick snippet for canary config i want in the doc:
```yaml
canary:
  duration: 30m
  traffic_split: 10%
  metrics:
    - name: p99_latency
      threshold: 220ms
    - name: quality_regression
      threshold: 2.0% # fail if >2%
  rollback_on: [p99_latency, quality_regression]
```

chloe: will run a kernel-level A/B and quantized A/B during canary. we should pin model version and quant recipe in the rollout metadata.

maria: customer ask: show worst-case SLA behavior and costs for a 99th percentile spike scenario. can marketing get a one-pager?

kevin: yes, we'll produce a one-pager post-criteria. first focus on hitting Proposal A. meeting tomorrow 10am to finalize.

sam: noted. i'll queue perf traces and add a quick script to sample long-tail sequences for the run.

perf-bot: queued: nightly-run 1779803600 will include updated int8 kernels and KV eviction tuning. results will appear in /perf/runs/1779803600.

chloe: thanks all. objective: GA-ready criteria by EOD Thu so PMs can sign off. low-churn list only.

kevin: :thumbsup: closing thread — bring any blockers to the sync or ping me directly.
